TH-011.title: What does AlphaFold3 learn about antibody and nanobody docking, and what remains unsolved?
quotes: With twenty seeds, AF3 achieves a median unbound CDR H3 RMSD accuracy of 2.9 Å ... and 2.2 Å ... for antibodies and nanobodies, respectively.

TH-011.title: ImmuneBuilder: Deep-Learning models for predicting the structures of immune proteins
quotes: For example, on a benchmark of 34 recently solved antibodies, ABodyBuilder2 predicts CDR-H3 loops with an RMSD of 2.81Å, a 0.09Å improvement over AlphaFold-Multimer, while being over a hundred times faster.
Similar results are also achieved for nanobodies, (NanoBodyBuilder2 predicts CDR-H3 loops with an average RMSD of 2.89Å, a 0.55Å improvement over AlphaFold2) and TCRs.

TH-011.title: Toward high-resolution homology modeling of antibody Fv regions and application to antibody-antigen docking
quotes: The median root mean square deviation (rmsd) of the antigen binding pocket comprised of all the CDR residues was 1.5 A with 80% of the targets having an rmsd lower than 2.0 A.

The median backbone heavy atom global rmsd of the CDR H3 loop prediction was 1.6, 1.9, 2.4, 3.1, and 6.0 A for very short (4-6 residues), short (7-9), medium (10-11), long (12-14) and very long (17-22) loops, respectively.

TH-011.title: ABlooper: fast accurate antibody CDR loop structure prediction with accuracy estimation
quotes: On the models of the Rosetta Antibody Benchmark, ABlooper makes predictions with an average CDR-H3 RMSD of 2.49 Å, which drops to 2.05 Å when considering only its 75% most confident predictions.

TH-011.title: RosettaAntibodyDesign (RAbD): A general framework for computational antibody design
quotes: We tested RAbD experimentally on both a lambda and kappa antibody-antigen complex, successfully improving their affinities 10 to 50 fold by replacing individual CDRs of the native antibody with new CDR lengths and clusters.

TH-011.title: Integrating deep learning, threading alignments, and a multi-MSA strategy for high-quality protein monomer and complex structure prediction in CASP15
quotes: For 47 free modeling targets in CASP15, the final models predicted by D-I-TASSER showed average TM-score 19% higher than the standard AlphaFold2 program.

For the 38 complex targets, DMFold-Multimer generated models with an average TM-score of 0.83 and Interface Contact Score of 0.60, both significantly higher than those of competing complex prediction tools.
